links.outcome: Adherence of LLM antiemetic prophylaxis recommendations to SAMBA guidelines
links.effect: Only 31% correct antiemetic recommendations versus SAMBA guidelines (kappa 0.141); Apfel score correct in 99/100 profiles and 98% risk-category concordance.
links.quote: However, its recommendations of antiemetic agents as per the SAMBA guidelines are inconsistent, necessitating human oversight for guideline-based management.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's baseline accuracy in risk calculation and guideline adherence on simulated patient profiles without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
